# Andreas Roet — andreasroet.de

> Dub techno producer and sound designer. Hardware live sets (Elektron Octatrack MK2, Analog Rytm MK1), records, and producer tools under the TechnoSupps brand.

## What this site offers
- Sample packs and preset packs for dub techno production, sold via Gumroad: https://technosupps.gumroad.com
- Production tutorials (sound design, mixing, hardware workflow): https://andreasroet.de/blog
- Music: label releases, self-published records (Bandcamp), live sets (SoundCloud): https://andreasroet.de/music

## Key pages
- Shop: https://andreasroet.de/shop
- Tutorials & Blog: https://andreasroet.de/blog
- Music: https://andreasroet.de/music
- About: https://andreasroet.de/about

## Style
Producer-to-producer, direct, no hype. English.
